body: Port of OpenAI's Whisper model in C/C++
plain_description: **Turn audio into text with a fast, self-hosted speech recognition tool.** Run transcription on your own computer or device. It supports offline use across desktop, mobile, and browser projects.
technical_description: whisper.cpp is a C/C++ implementation for running OpenAI Whisper speech recognition models. It supports CPU inference and acceleration on NVIDIA and AMD GPUs, Apple Silicon, and several NPUs. It includes command-line transcription, streaming, an HTTP transcription server with an OAI-like API, and bindings and examples for multiple platforms. Models use a custom GGML format, with integer quantization support.
title: whisper.cpp
